ops.body: Measured on the live host after deploying 12.92.8 on 2026-10-10: the prepared-fact ledger (inside retained_projection_bytes) rose from 118 MiB at 15:25:41 to 498 MiB at 15:31:54 and held at 522 MiB from 15:34:55 on. Prepared-cache reads were 12 until the cache filled, then 168, 323, 129 and 263 MiB per minute over the next four intervals; by 15:40:33 the owner had made 5,727 reads (1,820 MiB) against 3,515 entries (1,196 MiB) written. So the host-wide fact working set across registered sessions is larger than 512 MiB and evicted facts are read back from disk. 512 MiB was sized from one registry (337 MB). Open question for the owner: size the budget from the host-wide set, cut reads per request (fix 1, task cd82ced), or shrink the set. These are logical bytes; physical IO was not measured. Owner RSS was 1,686 MiB at 15:40.
